Progress

Status indicators built on role="progressbar". The determinate bar carries aria-valuenow/aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax with a --color-action fill on a --color-surface-sunken track at --radius-pill; at 100% it shifts to --color-success. The indeterminate bar drops aria-valuenow, sets aria-busy="true", and sweeps a token-colored stripe. The spinner is the circular variant for compact loading states. Per the WAI-ARIA APG, progressbars are non-interactive status widgets with no keyboard model; dynamic value changes are announced through an aria-live="polite" region. All motion honors prefers-reduced-motion. Both themes below render the full state set.

Light theme

Uploading transcript 42%
Determinate — value animates; the % read-out is a polite live region.
Enrollment submitted 100%
Complete — fill shifts to --color-success.
Syncing records
Indeterminate — aria-busy="true", no aria-valuenow.
Loading…
Spinner — circular variant; icon-only, labelled via aria-label.

Uploading transcript 42%

Copy-paste snippet

<!-- DETERMINATE: role=progressbar + aria-valuenow/min/max.
     Set the fill width inline via --hisd-progress-value and keep it in
     sync with aria-valuenow. Add --complete when valuenow == valuemax. -->
<div class="hisd-progress-field">
  <div class="hisd-progress-field__header">
    <span class="hisd-progress-field__label" id="up-label">Uploading transcript</span>
    <span class="hisd-progress-field__value" id="up-value" aria-live="polite">42%</span>
  </div>
  <div class="hisd-progress" role="progressbar"
       aria-labelledby="up-label"
       aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="42"
       aria-describedby="up-value"
       style="--hisd-progress-value: 42%;">
    <span class="hisd-progress__fill"></span>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- COMPLETE: valuenow == valuemax, add the modifier. -->
<div class="hisd-progress hisd-progress--complete" role="progressbar"
     aria-label="Enrollment submitted"
     aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="100"
     style="--hisd-progress-value: 100%;">
  <span class="hisd-progress__fill"></span>
</div>

<!-- INDETERMINATE: drop aria-valuenow, set aria-busy="true". -->
<div class="hisd-progress hisd-progress--indeterminate" role="progressbar"
     aria-label="Syncing records" aria-busy="true">
  <span class="hisd-progress__fill"></span>
</div>

<!-- SPINNER (circular variant): icon-only, label with aria-label. -->
<span class="hisd-spinner" role="progressbar"
      aria-label="Loading" aria-busy="true"></span>
